verdict.rationale: Paperspace serves a versioned API: the production OpenAPI 3.0.3 document is at /v1/openapi.json with version "1" and the server base is https://api.paperspace.com/v1, and the published API reference is generated from it. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-change guarantees, so only half the story is delivered. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, a changelog or versioning guarantees beyond the /v1 path, and independent corroboration of API stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The production API domain serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at /v1/openapi.json (info title "Paperspace OpenAPI", version "1", 61 paths; servers https://api.paperspace.com/v1).
The path without /v1 answers 404; the versioned path is the artifact.
